description.value: Sushi Inn is a Japanese sushi restaurant in Vancouver's Kitsilano neighbourhood, operating under the registered name New Joy Food Services LTD. It offers both dine-in with table reservations and a fully online takeout ordering system with an order-ahead feature. Cyclists stopping for a meal can place their order before arriving to minimize wait time.
